text:
zoe-sales: Heads up — Nimbus Health procurement sent requirements: PO + countersigned MSA before POC start. Pilot billing: separate PO for pilot, net-45, prefer scanned signed PDF (no DocuSign), customer requests customer-controlled KMS/HSM option, asks for SOC2 Type II and a DPA with subprocessors list. Need legal/finance/security input. cc @leo-se @mike-legal @anya-fin @tara-security

leo-se: Quick clarifying q's: are they procuring Dedicated or Hosted for the pilot? start date? need to prepare POC order form + addendum to lock pricing and billing split.

zoe-sales: Dedicated (Dedicated-Small, 4x A100 equiv), 30-day pilot, target start Mon 2026-04-06. Estimated pilot cost ~$18k. Procurement contact ap@nimbus.com. They will issue a PO number for the pilot invoice.

leo-se: I'll sketch an order form snippet we can send along with the POC addendum. Suggest pilot as standalone invoice + separate prospective subscription order form that is not executed until post-pilot. Draft snippet: ```Order Form (excerpt)
Customer: Nimbus Health
Product: Redwood Dedicated - Dedicated-Small
Term: 30 days (Pilot)
Billing: Invoice to ap@nimbus.com, net 45
PO: Required prior to start; reference PO# on invoice
Notes: Pilot invoiced separately from subscription/renewal```

anya-fin: Net-45 acceptable. For pilots under $50k we can accept standard PO+invoice path without special sign-off. Split invoicing is OK but require distinct PO numbers for pilot vs subscription. On DocuSign: we prefer e-sign but if customer forbids it we can provide an exec-signed PDF scan; procurement must confirm acceptance in writing.

mike-legal: Key legal items: DPA with subprocessor disclosure, liability cap for pilot, indemnity scope, SLA language. For pilots we use a POC Addendum that: (1) limits pilot liability to a temporary cap, (2) notes DPA coverage and marks certain subprocessors as pending onboarding, and (3) accepts scanned exec signature if procurement provides explicit email confirmation. Need security to advise BYOK vs Redwood-managed KMS implications for the DPA. I'll draft addendum + cover email template.

tara-security: Need to know if Nimbus requires full BYOK (customer holds key material in their HSM) or customer-managed KMS integrated with Redwood where keys are in KMS but Redwood can use them via EKM. BYOK full custody impacts our onboarding (3-5 business days) and DPA key custody clauses. If PHI is involved we will need a BAA. Request Nimbus shares SOC2 report and any encryption spec.

zoe-sales: I'll ask procurement to confirm: acceptance of scanned exec-signed PDF for the POC, whether BYOK is mandatory or Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable, and timeline for issuing PO.

leo-se: Operational path: 1) prepare Pilot Order Form + POC Addendum (pilot terms, reduced cap, invoice instructions) 2) prepare placeholder master/subscription order not executed yet. If they insist on no e-sign, legal will provide scanned PDF signed by exec and send via email when procurement confirms acceptance. Mike: can you produce a short cover note to attach?

mike-legal: Yes 12 I'll create the POC Addendum template and a one-line cover email confirming scanned signature accepted for POC only (subject to procurement's written confirmation). Will also mark DPA redline spots; Tara flag if BYOK requires explicit amendment to key custody clause. Expect draft by EOD today.

anya-fin: Once draft is ready, Zoe send to ap@nimbus.com with billing instructions form. Finance will generate pilot invoice when PO arrives. If they give two POs, ensure they reference pilot PO for pilot invoice and subscription PO placeholder for future billing.

tara-security: If BYOK/HSM is chosen, we need integration details and timeline (estimate 3-5 business days to onboard keys). Call this out in the POC timeline. We'll provide our SOC2 on secure share after they provide theirs. If PHI, request their compliance attach.

zoe-sales: Update from procurement (ap@nimbus.com): they will accept an exec-signed scanned PDF for the POC only; BYOK preferred but Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable if HSM-backed and provides audit logs. They will issue PO tomorrow AM. I'll drop PO here when received.

leo-se: Great. Action items: Mike: draft POC Addendum + cover email; Tara: review BYOK impact and DPA wording; Anya: billing instructions template; Zoe: follow-up with procurement and post PO.

anya-fin: Standing by for PO.

mike-legal: Draft uploaded to internal drive, pinging Tara and Anya for review. Will finalize and send to Zoe for procurement as scanned exec-signed PDF once ap@nimbus.com confirms acceptance.

zoe-sales: PO arrived (PO# NH-20260406-01), attaching the PO PDF to email chain. Sending POC Addendum + billing form now.

leo-se: Proceed to schedule provisioning window. Tara, coordinate key onboarding if BYOK required. Anya, invoice link prepared after PO validated. :rocket:
